resolution_rule: Freeze the first BLS Employment Situation release describing October 2026, expected November 6, 2026 at 08:30 EST. Use the first-published seasonally adjusted one-month CHANGE in total nonfarm payroll employment (in jobs or thousands), not private employment, household employment, later revisions, a rolling average or an updated consensus. Event TRUE iff the first displayed payroll change is >=100000 jobs. Otherwise FALSE. Score frozen p=.40 with Brier and log loss. Independently score point +60000 jobs by absolute error, nominal 80% interval [-40000,160000] by coverage, and both frozen September +29000 and FactSet +55000 points by absolute error. If publication is delayed, hold pending to first actual release without changing this forecast or its cutoff.
rationale: Q3 advance real GDP was +3.4% annualized and private domestic final sales +4.9%; strong spending and capital investment favor activity resilience but the estimates measure a past quarter and are composition-sensitive.
October 29 initial claims for the week ending October 24 were only 194000; low separations do not establish high hiring (low-hire/low-fire distinction).
The first September payroll change was +29000 and an October 29 FactSet survey reported a +55000 consensus. The point +60000 is near, not demonstrably superior to, the external consensus.

September real disposable income fell 0.3% and real consumption was approximately flat m/m; energy-driven nominal strength and AI equipment/inventory spending can coexist with modest employment growth.
The p=.40 threshold tests whether aggregate GDP resilience is propagating to broad payroll gains; it is not a calibrated posterior backed by sufficient within-target repetitions.
surprising_if: First-release payroll growth is >=+160000, signaling unusually strong hiring despite recent subdued employment creation.
First-release payroll employment falls by more than 40000, indicating a sharper labor-demand break despite low current unemployment claims.
source_timing_note: No information released after evidence_cutoff is permitted to change this event, probability, point, interval or benchmarks.
